+def _quota_intervals(data):
+    jobs = data["jobs"]
+    k = data["k"]
+    blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    if mandatory & blocked:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    eligible = [job for job in jobs if job["id"] not in blocked]
+    best = None
+    best_value = None
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    for subset in combinations(eligible, k):
+        ids = {job["id"] for job in subset}
+        if not mandatory <= ids:
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in subset:
+            counts[job["group"]] = counts.get(job["group"], 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        intervals = sorted((job["start"], job["end"]) for job in subset)
+        ends = []
+        feasible = True
+        for start, end in intervals:
+            while ends and ends[0] <= start:
+                heapq.heappop(ends)
+            heapq.heappush(ends, end)
+            if len(ends) > 2:
+                feasible = False
+                break
+        if not feasible:
+            continue
+        names = sorted(ids)
+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in subset)
+        if best is None or value > best_value or (value == best_value and names < best):
+            best, best_value = names, value
+    if best is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": best, "value": best_value}
